title: AMP Fluidd Klipper Hardware Preflight 001 Checklist

checks.description: Physical U1 hardware is available for controlled validation.
checks.failure_action: Do not attempt Fluidd/Klipper AMP dry-run.
checks.evidence_required: Hardware serial, machine identity, or lab note confirming physical U1 access.

checks.description: Physical toolhead count is confirmed.
checks.failure_action: Stop until toolhead inventory is confirmed.
checks.evidence_required: Photo, configuration export, or written inventory.

checks.description: Installed nozzle size is confirmed for every physical toolhead.
checks.failure_action: Stop until physical nozzle state matches the intended tool map.
checks.evidence_required: Tool-by-tool nozzle inventory.

checks.description: Intended 0.2 / 0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 AMP tool map is documented.
checks.failure_action: Do not continue until AMP tool classes map to physical tools.
checks.evidence_required: Filled tool map with physical toolhead IDs.

checks.description: Material compatibility is confirmed per nozzle.
checks.failure_action: Stop until material/nozzle compatibility is reviewed.
checks.evidence_required: Material and nozzle compatibility note.

checks.description: 0.2 mm nozzle is not used with PETG-CF, PETG-GF, Wood, or TPU unless separately validated.
checks.failure_action: Remove restricted material/nozzle pairing or provide separate validation.
checks.evidence_required: Material selection note or separate validation record.

checks.description: Fluidd path is confirmed and touchscreen-started mixed-nozzle path remains blocked.
checks.failure_action: Do not attempt any mixed-nozzle dry-run from touchscreen.
checks.evidence_required: Operator note confirming Fluidd-only path.

checks.description: Custom firmware presence is confirmed before using any paxx12 U1 Extended Firmware research path.
checks.failure_action: Keep paxx12 adapter research-only and offline.
checks.evidence_required: Operator note confirming whether custom firmware is present on the target machine.

checks.description: Firmware source and version are recorded.
checks.failure_action: Stop until firmware source and version are documented.
checks.evidence_required: Repository URL, release/tag/version, and machine firmware note.

checks.description: Recovery method is known before any custom firmware configuration work.
checks.failure_action: Stop until recovery path is documented.
checks.evidence_required: Recovery procedure reference or operator note.

checks.description: The extended/klipper include path is confirmed on the target hardware.
checks.failure_action: Do not prepare hardware-side macros until include path is verified.
checks.evidence_required: Fluidd/Mainsail configuration screenshot, file listing, or operator note.

checks.description: Macros are reviewed before any installation attempt.
checks.failure_action: Do not install or load AMP macro files.
checks.evidence_required: Reviewed macro diff or signed operator note.

checks.description: No sandbox file is installed without review.
checks.failure_action: Do not copy generated sandbox files to the printer.
checks.evidence_required: Operator note confirming sandbox files remained offline or were reviewed before any copy.

checks.description: The paxx12 adapter remains research_only until hardware evidence exists.
checks.failure_action: Keep the adapter disabled/offline.
checks.evidence_required: Hardware validation record before status can change.

checks.description: Emergency stop access is confirmed before any motion-capable test.
checks.failure_action: Stop until emergency stop is verified.
checks.evidence_required: Operator note or photo showing emergency stop access.

checks.description: Homing behavior is confirmed.
checks.failure_action: Stop until homing is understood.
checks.evidence_required: Dry-run or machine-state note.

checks.description: Bed is clear and parking/docking coordinates are known.
checks.failure_action: Stop until machine space and parking positions are safe.
checks.evidence_required: Bed-clear note and parking/docking coordinate record.

checks.description: Tool offsets are known for every physical tool.
checks.failure_action: Stop until offsets are measured or confirmed.
checks.evidence_required: Tool offset table.

checks.description: Z offsets are checked for every physical tool.
checks.failure_action: Stop until Z offset behavior is understood.
checks.evidence_required: Z offset table or calibration note.

checks.description: Purge/wipe behavior is observed before extrusion-capable tests.
checks.failure_action: Stop until purge/wipe behavior is characterized.
checks.evidence_required: Purge/wipe observation note.

checks.description: AMP plan packet validator passes.
checks.failure_action: Regenerate or fix AMP packet before any hardware work.
checks.evidence_required: Validator output path or pasted result.

checks.description: Firmware adapter output validator passes.
checks.failure_action: Do not continue until adapter outputs are verified non-printable.
checks.evidence_required: Firmware adapter validation report.

checks.description: Generated sandbox files are comments-only or dry-run only.
checks.failure_action: Stop and regenerate sandbox files.
checks.evidence_required: Sandbox command scan result.

checks.description: Step 0 offline validation has passed.
checks.failure_action: Do not proceed to hardware dry-run.
checks.evidence_required: Offline validation reports.

checks.description: Step 1 air/dry-run with no heating and no extrusion is complete.
checks.failure_action: Do not proceed to tool selection tests.
checks.evidence_required: Air/dry-run observation note.

checks.description: Step 2 single-tool dry-run is complete.
checks.failure_action: Do not proceed to two-tool dry-run.
checks.evidence_required: Single-tool dry-run note.

checks.description: Step 3 two-tool dry-run with no extrusion is complete.
checks.failure_action: Do not proceed to same-nozzle toolchange test.
checks.evidence_required: Two-tool dry-run note.

checks.description: Step 4 single material / same nozzle size toolchange test is complete.
checks.failure_action: Do not proceed to Fluidd-only mixed-nozzle test.
checks.evidence_required: Same-nozzle toolchange observation note.
